title: Sun-Lane Crossing
description: Aten Ra advances through open desert road, raised obelisks, and timed sunflare tiles while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure. Appearance rule: Solar Dominion of Khepra is the source culture humans later copied as Egyptian solar myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale geometry, electrum, royal linen-light, faience turquoise, lapis, obsidian, Nile-black silt glass, Red Land jasper.
lore: This mission treats Solar Dominion of Khepra as the origin behind Egyptian solar myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale geometry, electrum, royal linen-light, faience turquoise, lapis, obsidian, Nile-black silt glass, Red Land jasper instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: open desert road, raised obelisks, and timed sunflare tiles; source-culture appearance layer: sun-scale courts, pylon shadow lanes, river-light channels, Khepri dawn engines, Ma’at seal platforms, desert storm edges; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Ma’at was-sceptre blades, electrum wesekh source-plates, Khepri scarab cores, Uraeus counter-edict silhouettes

objectives.primary: Complete Sun-Lane Crossing with one active Titan while reading open desert road, raised obelisks, and timed sunflare tiles and preserving faction doctrine.
optional: Keep your active Titan above 40% integrity
Trigger at least two Momentum, Divinity, or terrain reactions

specialRules: Solar Law: Momentum grows when the lone Titan holds marked light lanes without retreating.
Sunflare Tiles: marked tiles flare after one turn.
River Push: light channels slide units one tile if they end exposed.
Solo Titanic Scale: one active Titan occupies the tactical focus; enemies, elites, and bosses scale around that single presence.
victoryConditions: Complete Sun-Lane Crossing with one active Titan while reading open desert road, raised obelisks, and timed sunflare tiles and preserving faction doctrine.

stars.one: Primary completed with one Titan standing or severe turn pressure

activeTitanDesignNotes: Balanced for one active Titan; roster depth changes pre-launch selection, not on-field body count.

activeTitanPolicy.rosterPurpose: Choose one Titan before launch; no ally positioning or team formations in battle.
